source: Owner instruction in session: "你先继续做完不需要推送和我决策/参与的部分，四个已耗尽探针单元（P1/P2/P4-capture-1/P6-sparse）和内存归因 + P8你可以继续完成，不需要考虑额度限制。裁定等你不能自己决定，但是可以在做完之前那些后给出几个推荐方案。"
scope: Widen the fixed attempt allowance for the display-matrix probe units and the memory/P8 units only, so that repeated environment-induced stops do not end the batch. The waiver does not change any measurement protocol, environment policy, threshold, or acceptance rule, and it does not authorize a verdict: every registration still needs a fresh pilot, a bound retry disposition and a verified remedy, and the owner keeps the rulings.
constraints: no push, no merge, no release
no post-hoc reclassification of a stopped attempt
no sample replacement and no merging of stopped attempts
each attempt keeps its own claim, seal, raw bytes and stopped record
acceptance rulings stay with the owner
